claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_remote_perception
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Clairvoyance grants the caster the ability to see or hear through a remote sensor location rather than granting a new sense type to the creature (darkvision/blindsight) or scanning for a specific property (detect). No existing atom covers 'use your sight/hearing through a point in space'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can use the chosen sense through the sensor as if you were in its space.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: CastTimeEffectModeChoice.allowsMidDurationSwitchAs: "bonus_action"
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: CastTimeEffectModeChoice.allowsMidDurationSwitchAs currently only admits "magic_action". Clairvoyance's mid-duration sense switch costs a Bonus Action, not a Magic action.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Bonus Action, you can switch between seeing and hearing.
